name: CorrespondentRouting
description: Records the correspondent banking chain selected by SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003) for routing a SWIFT international payment to the beneficiary bank. Created in PH-032 (SWIFT Message Assembly). The correspondent_chain is an ordered array of ISO 9362 BICs representing the route from the bank's first correspondent to the beneficiary bank. The nostro_account is the bank's account at the first correspondent, which is debited for the transfer amount in PH-033. All BICs in the correspondent_chain are screened for sanctions in PH-031. Owned by SVC-010. Introduced by JRN-009.
owning_capability: CAP-003 (Payment Operations — International Payments, promoted sub-capability CAP-003.04)

fields.name: correspondent_chain
fields.validation_rule: Required. Ordered array of ISO 9362 BIC codes (8 or 11 characters). Minimum 1 entry (direct correspondent). Maximum 5 entries (SWIFT gpi maximum hop count). Each BIC must be active in the SWIFT BIC directory. All BICs in this array must have been screened for sanctions in PH-031 before CorrespondentRouting is created.

fields.name: nostro_account
fields.validation_rule: Required. The bank's nostro account number at the first correspondent in correspondent_chain[0]. Format varies by correspondent (IBAN for EEA; BBAN or proprietary for others). Debited by SVC-009 (same-capability call from SVC-010) in PH-033.

fields.name: charges_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: OUR | SHA | BEN. Denormalised from InternationalTransfer.charges_type for SWIFT pacs.008 construction. Maps to ISO 20022 ChargeBearerCode: OUR = DEBT, SHA = SHAR, BEN = CRED.

fields.name: routing_selected_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of routing selection. Immutable.

relationships.description: CorrespondentRouting belongs to one InternationalTransfer via transfer_id.

design_decisions.decision: correspondent_chain is stored as an ordered array of BICs on CorrespondentRouting rather than as separate CorrespondentHop entities.
design_decisions.rationale: The correspondent chain is determined at message assembly time and is immutable thereafter. An ordered array is sufficient for both SWIFT pacs.008 construction and sanctions screening fan-out. A separate CorrespondentHop entity with per-hop gpi status would be appropriate for a dedicated SWIFT gpi monitoring journey — deferred to that journey.
